expectations.evidence: 'An SLO is a low-priced product offered right after the opt-in ... priced so that front-end sales pay back the ad spend'; gives the book's example '$100 of ads brings 100 leads ... 10% buy a $10 product ... break-even' — matches SKILL.md exactly.

'Break-even day is the day on which total revenue from a group of leads equals what you paid'; cites book's 5% + another 5% by day 3 example and the $1/name/month vs $3 lead = month 3 version — both match SKILL.md.

expectations.text: Does concrete math on $2/lead with a conversion rate and price
expectations.evidence: Table of conversion needed at $2 CPL ($7 -> 30.8%, $17 -> 12.3% ...) and a per-100-leads model: $17 front end at 10%, $9.95 bump at 30%, $47 OTO at 15% -> net $2.46/lead; break-even ≈ 8.2% conversion.
